_doc: «Волны» (T4.2, docs/06 §7.2, copy of Яндекс «Моя волна» + Apple Music/AMLL, docs/01a §B). Hue anchors are the vibe corners (valence × arousal, 0…1): sad = low/low, angry = low/high, joy = high/high, calm = high/low.

motion._doc: T4.5, FR-VIZ-002: the vibe vector → motion, continuous (no table). Unknown features count as 0.5. speed ← arousal·w + energy·w over `speed`; warp base ← energy and aggression over `warp_base`; beat gain ← danceability over `beat_gain`; glints ← 1 − acousticness over `sparkle_gain`; grain ← acousticness over `grain`.
